question: Myringotomy in acute suppurative otitis media is performed in the anteroinferior quadrant of the tympanic membrane.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. The anteroinferior quadrant is the correct and mandatory site. The posteroinferior quadrant risks the round window; the superior quadrants risk the ossicular chain and facial nerve. Anteroinferior is the only safe quadrant.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The anteroinferior quadrant is the safe zone: it is the farthest from the ossicles (superiorly) and from the facial nerve (posteriorly), and avoids the round window niche inferoposteriorly. This is a non-negotiable rule.
